policy.unreleased: Suoming CONFIRMED_UPCOMING is excluded. Hsin/Jingran released identity does not promote Hero Art; source review remains Pending.
policy.presentation: Explicit reviewed metadata only. Never auto-center from transparent image bounds.

presentationUnits.scale: Unitless multiplier applied inside the Character-local focus art frame.
presentationUnits.offsetX: Percentage points of the Character-local focus art frame; positive moves right.
presentationUnits.offsetY: Percentage points of the Character-local focus art frame; positive moves down.

visualReview.note: All READY Characters retain explicit Character-local CONTAIN defaults (scale 1, x/y 0, focal 0.5/0.5) unless a later review proves a Character-specific correction is needed. The required seven silhouettes were reviewed in the real Build workspace at all three desktop targets; nine obvious wide/asymmetric outliers were additionally reviewed from real 1440x900 Build-focus evidence. No alpha-bound auto-centering, upscaling, crop generation, or fabricated artwork was used.
